picks.name: Lambswool Saddle Shoulder Crew Neck, Navy
picks.why: Knits are still the biggest gap with none owned, and the office, date and outdoor outfits all lean on one. A plain navy lambswool crew knitted in Hawick, saddle shoulder rather than drop shoulder, no branding, L in stock. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s under the waxed jacket.

picks.name: 7006 Essential T-Shirt, Norway Spruce
picks.why: Tees are the other open gap. An enzyme-washed organic cotton crew in a dark muted green, 30% off, with only a tiny hem tab, and L is one of the last sizes left. Wear it under the navy crew or the grey marl raglan sweat with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: Wallabee Shoe, Maple Suede
picks.why: A Black Friday-list watch-list BUY at £79.20 (was £99), UK 10 in stock, and the brown suede Chelseas just sold out in 10. There's no smart-casual shoe besides the Docs, and a matte maple suede Wallabee covers office and date night with the fawn chinos and navy crew, or the 502s on weekends. Wallabees run large: true size for normal feet; spray the suede before rain.
